reference_cohort: fixed before candidate outcomes; exact cluster IDs and source digest required by any execution request

event_retention.estimand: R(X) is the equal-unit mean over the fixed REF cohort of exclusive REF events retained by that REF unit's single reciprocal primary partner divided by the REF unit's event count; unmatched REF units contribute zero
event_retention.scope: continuity proxy only; not biological identity or novel-event recovery

uncertainty.scope: fixed-cohort composition sensitivity, not repeated-recording or biological-population inference

margin_review.concrete_issue: the lower bound may include effects below 0.05 even when the point estimate exceeds 0.05

cells.bounds: half-open integer sample cells using frozen ceiling-converted edges and the exact recording stop
cells.use: state and longitudinal diagnostics only; never primary ranking or identity

required_disclosure: per-unit REF, candidate, and common support
conditional effect only among supported pairs

forbidden: cross-arm outcome computation before separate reviewed execution request
